summary: Marasoft dynamic-account in-app deposit flow tested end-to-end. Backend (8/8 pytest cases) and frontend (9/9 UI checks) all pass. Bank-transfer card renders inline with real Wema Bank virtual account from Marasoft; no external redirect occurs. Regression checks (login, history, quick-amount chips, withdraw page PIN) also pass.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_user.py is ~1257 lines — consider splitting deposit / withdrawal / referrals / pin into separate route modules for maintainability.

/deposit/initialize returns 502 on Marasoft failure but the deposit row is already marked 'failed' — frontend currently surfaces the toast error; UX is acceptable but consider returning a structured error code so the client can show a guided retry.

marasoft.create_dynamic_account: amount sent as whole-naira string (per docs) but Marasoft also returns 'amount_to_pay' that we ignore. If Marasoft ever adds processing fees, the user could under-transfer. Consider surfacing amount_to_pay if it differs from requested amount.
test_credentials: User 08099887766 / newpwd (PIN 1234, security Rex/Smith). Admin not tested per request.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded user. Test created 1 live Marasoft virtual account (Wema 9021207344) — no money moved, deposit will time out as 'failed' on verify.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marasoft is a live integration via Fixie proxy. POST /api/deposit/initialize with deposit_gateway=marasoft returns {type:'bank_transfer', gateway:'marasoft', mode:'live', reference, amount, account_number, account_name, bank_name} — NO authorization_url. Frontend Deposit.jsx renders inline bank card with data-testid='deposit-bank-instructions' and sub-testids dep-bank/dep-acct-no/dep-acct-name/dep-amount. Verify endpoint correctly returns 'failed'/'pending' when no transfer made. All test cases live in /app/backend/tests/test_deposit_marasoft.py.
